items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] All right. Gary Smulyan, who told me jazz is four things...

ctx.x: I come from the 50s. You’ve got to be cool. I’m really beat. I’m not a hippie, I’m really beat. You’ve got to be cool.
All right. Gary Smulyan, who told me jazz is four things and among the four things he said can you play what you feel. How does that strike you?
Vague. Yeah you play what you feel. You play — Sam Rivers told me, he says, “Sometimes I improvise just using my mind, not what I hear, sometimes I improvise © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
